option_relations.rationale: Primary iris B-cell lymphoma matches the description of the iris lesion and biopsy results.
Primary B-cell lymphoma of the iris (CD20+) matches the immunohistochemistry results and description of the iris lesion.
Intraocular marginal zone lymphoma (MALT lymphoma) is a subtype of lymphoma that could be related to the iris lesion.
